hotel_name: Tambo del Inka, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Valle Sagrado

claims.text: The resort is set beside the Urubamba River along the Incan path, inspired by the ancient tambos that gave rest to travelers heading to Machu Picchu.

findings.quote: Set along the legendary Incan path, beside the flowing Urubamba River, Tambo del Inka draws inspiration from the ancient tambos that once offered rest and refuge to travelers on their journey to Machu Picchu.

claims.text: The train from the hotel's station uses 1920s-style carriages, including a Dining Car and a panoramic Observation Bar Car.

findings.quote: Our hotel with a private train station to Machu Picchu provides an unforgettable journey between Urubamba and the famous Inca site.
Luxurious 1920s-style carriages—including a Dining Car and a panoramic Observation Bar Car—gourmet cuisine and the highest quality service all combine to create an unforgettable experience.

claims.text: Kallpa Spa offers treatments using traditional Incan ingredients.

findings.quote: Delight in a wide variety of treatments using traditional Incan ingredients at Kallpa Spa.

claims.text: The resort has a heated indoor pool.

findings.quote: rejuvenate at our spa, heated indoor pool, and fitness center

claims.text: A number of suites have private balconies and terraces.

findings.quote: a number of suites providing private balconies and terraces

claims.text: Suites have wooden details and luxurious bedding.

findings.quote: Our hotel suites in Sacred Valley, Urubamba, will dazzle you with beautiful wooden details, luxurious bedding, and incredible views just outside your private balcony.

claims.text: All rooms and suites have Le Chemin bath amenities from BYREDO.

findings.quote: Pamper yourself with Le Chemin bath amenities from BYREDO, in all rooms and suites

claims.text: Hawa Restaurant serves novo Andean cuisine featuring organic, homegrown ingredients.

findings.quote: Enjoy innovative novo Andean cuisine at our luxury hotel restaurant in Sacred...See More Valley, Peru, Hawa Restaurant, where organic, homegrown ingredients are featured in each and every dish.

claims.text: Kiri Bar has a gin menu, pisco-based drinks and a terrace with views of the Sacred Valley.

findings.quote: featuring a gin menu, pisco-based drinks, and exquisite appetizers. Enjoy the terrace with views of the Sacred Valley

claims.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge team members are bilingual, certified destination experts who wear the Les Clefs d'Or insignia.

findings.quote: Each Luxury Collection Concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert, proudly wearing “Les Clefs d’Or,” the gilt insignia of the celebrated international concierge society

claims.text: Accommodations face either the Urubamba River or the cordillera and the Chicon glacier.

findings.quote: Accommodations face either the Urubamba River or the cordillera and the Chicón glacier.

claims.text: The hotel has a private train station with service to Machu Picchu.

findings.quote: Our hotel with a private train station to Machu Picchu provides an unforgettable journey between Urubamba and the famous Inca site.

claims.text: Kallpa Spa features a thermal circuit, underwater beds, a couples massage room with Jacuzzi and relaxation rooms with starry ceilings.

findings.quote: Kallpa Spa features a thermal circuit, underwater beds, a massage room for couples with Jacuzzi, relaxation rooms with starry ceiling

claims.text: Rooms look out on the Andes Mountains, the Vilcanota River or the resort gardens.

findings.quote: Take in views of the Andes Mountains, Vilcanota River or our resort gardens from your hotel room

claims.text: Interiors weave ancient motifs into contemporary decor, including fireplaces sculpted out of Inca-style stone walls.

findings.quote: Designer Roberto Caparra’s imaginative interiors weave ancient motifs into the contemporary decor: towering fireplaces sculpted out of Inca-style stone walls

claims.text: The resort has an onsite 2,000 square-meter organic garden producing vegetables, legumes and aromatic herbs.

findings.quote: Tambo del Inka features an onsite 2,000 m² organic garden producing organic vegetables, legumes, & aromatic herbs.

claims.text: Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport in Cusco is about 60 km from the hotel.

findings.quote: The closest airport near Tambo del Inka, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Valle Sagrado is Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport (CUZ). CUZ is located approximately 60.0 KM from the hotel.
